fact: As of 7 September 2026 Equatorial Guinea has no enacted AI statute or regulation; the transport, telecommunications and AI ministry is drafting an Anteproyecto de Ley de Inteligencia Artificial proposing the ANIAD regulator, which as of August 2025 had not been published for consultation or introduced in the legislature.
title: Equatorial Guinea: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
